name: Triangle Strip Voxel Projection
definition: A hardware-accelerated rendering method for voxel landscapes that replaces software span rendering with triangle strips. It projects voxels onto the screen in columns and constructs geometry based on the visibility of adjacent columns to minimize polygon count and utilize hardware interpolation.
summary: Triangle Strip Voxel Projection is a hardware-accelerated method that renders voxel landscapes by projecting columns into triangle strips, reducing draw calls and leveraging hardware interpolation.
